description:
PROFIL

• Abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung EFZ oder Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Engineering und Betrieb von Microsoft Teams in Enterprise-Umgebungen

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365 Collaboration Services wie Teams, SharePoint Online und OneDrive

• Erfahrung mit M365-Migrationen, Governance-, Security- und Lifecycle-Themen

• Erfahrung im 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support sowie Incident- und Problem-Management

• Kenntnisse in PowerShell von Vorteil sowie strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise

• Microsoft-Zertifizierungen (z. B. MS-700), ITIL Foundation oder Bereitschaft zur Weiterbildung

AUFGABEN

• Betrieb, Administration und Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft-365-Collaboration-Services mit Fokus auf Teams, SharePoint Online und OneDrive

• Umsetzung von Governance-, Security- und Lifecycle-Konzepten inklusive Berechtigungen, Provisioning und Compliance-Anforderungen

• Unterstützung bei Rollouts, Migrationen und der Einführung neuer M365-Features

• Zusammenarbeit mit Security-, Compliance- und Datenschutz-Teams

• Unterstützung des 2nd-/3rd-Level-Supports inklusive Dokumentation und Enablement

• Monitoring von Stabilität, Performance und Weiterentwicklungen innerhalb der Microsoft-Roadmap

• Weiterentwicklung von Automatisierungen, Self-Service-Lösungen sowie Zusammenarbeit mit externen Providern und Lieferanten

descriptionByLocale.it:
PROFIL
• Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica o laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o discipline equivalenti
• Esperienza pluriennale nell'ingegneria e nell'uso di Microsoft Teams in ambienti aziendali
• Buone conoscenze in Microsoft 365 Collaboration Services come Teams, SharePoint Online e OneDrive
• Esperienza con M365-Migrationi, Governance-, Security- e Lifecycle-Themen
• Esperienza nel 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support e Incident- e Problem-Management
• Conoscenze in PowerShell di vantaggio, insieme a una metodologia di lavoro strutturata e analitica
• Certificazioni Microsoft (ad esempio MS-700), ITIL Foundation o disponibilità a formarsi AUFGABEN
• Gestione, amministrazione e sviluppo dei servizi di collaborazione Microsoft 365 con enfasi su Teams, SharePoint Online e OneDrive
• Implementazione di concetti di Governance-, Security- e Lifecycle, inclusi autorizzazioni, provisioning e requisiti di conformità
• Supporto per i rilasci, le migrazioni e l'introduzione di nuove funzionalità M365
• Collaborazione con i team di Security-, Compliance- e Datenschutz
• Supporto del 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support, inclusa la documentazione e l'abilitazione
• Monitoraggio della stabilità, delle prestazioni e delle evoluzioni all'interno della roadmap Microsoft
• Sviluppo di automatizzazioni, soluzioni di autoassistenza e collaborazione con fornitori e fornitori esterni
descriptionByLocale.en:
PROFILE
• Completed degree in Computer Science or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or comparable field
• Multiple years of experience in engineering and operation of Microsoft Teams in Enterprise environments
• Good knowledge in Microsoft 365 Collaboration Services such as Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive
• Experience with M365 migrations, Governance, Security and Lifecycle topics
• Experience in 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support and Incident and Problem-Management
• Knowledge of PowerShell is an advantage as well as a structured and analytical working method
• Microsoft Certifications (e.g. MS-700), ITIL Foundation or willingness to further education TASKS
• Operation, administration and further development of Microsoft 365 Collaboration Services with focus on Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive
• Implementation of Governance, Security and Lifecycle concepts including permissions, provisioning and compliance requirements
• Support for rollouts, migrations and introduction of new M365 features
• Collaboration with Security, Compliance and Data Protection teams
• Support of 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support including documentation and enablement
• Monitoring of stability, performance and developments within the Microsoft Roadmap
• Further development of automations, self-service solutions and collaboration with external providers and suppliers
• Support of the 2nd-/3rd-Level-Support including documentation and enablement
